messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Stan is now in AUR (ArchLinux)
parts:
Ido Rosen sent us the following mail, which I'm just
passing on to the mailing lists as Ido suggested:

------------------------------
I just added Stan to AUR at:

https://aur.archlinux.org/packages/stanc/

(The package name "stan" was already taken, so I went with stanc.)

The package can be installed for ArchLinux users through, for example:

yaourt -S stanc

Feel free to forward this to the stan-dev mailing list if you'd like.

Cheers,
Ido
------------------------------
